text:
kevin: heads up — dashboard shows huge provisional token spike for route handoffs around 11:10. looks like retries + route debounce are double-counting :grimace:
jun: can you paste the trace id?
kevin: trace=rt-9f3b, here's the quick log snippet i grabbed:
```
STREAM START id=rt-9f3b user=acct-42 route=pool-a
ROUTE_CHANGE -> pool-b at t+120ms
RETRY(1) partial_tokens=37
STREAM END final_tokens=142 ack=true
```

jun: yep. what seems to be happening: when the session moves routes we emit provisional credits for the in-flight chunk, then retry emits another provisional until final ack consolidates. console currently shows both provisional entries separately.
tess: oof. users will freak at the spike. options: 1) debounce provisional emission on route changes, 2) emit but mark as stacked so UI groups them, 3) expose provisional vs confirmed filter in billing UI.
anika: i like debounce but worried about latency in real-time meters for power users. if we buffer for too long ops/alerting could miss real issues.
sara: also need to think about internal API semantics — the internal metering service currently accepts events as independent; adding debounce means dedupe logic with session ids and sequence numbers. that will complicate audit trails.
jun: proposal: add an apply_debounce flag to internal/rate_events with param `debounce_ms` (default 0). when >0, provisional events for same session+prefix are held for up to debounce_ms waiting for confirmation. if confirmed event arrives, emit only final. if timeout, flush provisional as-is.
kevin: 👍 makes it opt-in for rollouts. what about telemetry — we need both raw events and post-debounce aggregates for reconciliations.
sara: create two counters: raw_provisional_events and post_debounce_emitted_events. store original events in short-term journal (TTL 24h) for audits.
tess: console UX: add a toggle "Show provisional tokens" with a little tooltip explaining provisional vs confirmed. default off for billing teams, default on for dev console. also add a smoothing graph that shows "peak before debounce" vs "after debounce".
anika: rollout plan — start with debounce_ms=200ms for Dedicated customers only, run for 2 weeks, compare provisional delta and support tickets. then increase to 500ms if stable.
jun: edge cases: toolcalls that truncate mid-stream. we might get a confirmed ack with lower final_tokens than provisional. debounce should prefer final ack but still record the provisional -> final delta for regression alerts.
kevin: good call. also, how will this interact with routing policy fallback? if we route to cheaper pool then fallback to premium, we might intentionally want provisional to show at higher pool to charge appropriately. debounce could mask that.
sara: add `route_tag` and `route_cost_tier` on the provisional events so when consolidated we can attribute costs by time-weighted split if needed. the consolidation step can compute a weighted billing entry: e.g., 30% tokens on pool-a, 70% on pool-b.
tess: UI should surface the attribution breakdown when you click a session row. cheap win.
ops-bot: deploy queued: metering-service debounce feature -> staging at 2023-11-22T02:15Z (ci-1245).
kevin: sweet. next: can we add a small telemetry experiment to track customer confusion? event: `billing_ui_toggle_provisional` + follow-up NPS email for a sample of affected customers.
anika: agree. assign owners? jun for api impl, sara for storage/journal, tess for console changes, kevin for rollout + comms.
jun: will draft RFC and a small proto change for internal/rate_events today. will include example flow and sample span tags: `session.id`, `event.type`=(provisional|confirmed), `debounce_ms`, `route_tag`.
sara: i'll add a retention plan for the journal + ensure HSM keys used for sensitive ids.
tess: i'll mock a dashboard with before/after curves and a per-session expand view.
kevin: thanks. if no objections i'll mark this ready for RFC review at EOD. :thumbsup:
anika: no objections from me. leaning approve.
kevin: cool — filing RFC link in #eng-docs when ready.
